items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, 53% air yards; LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most TE yds).
items.why: Volume + matchup data; Collins absence confirmed.

items.text: Drake London avg >20 PPR/35% tgt/97 yds in 12 career games w/ Penix. Schultz 30% routes targeted / 28% tgt share w/ Collins out; faces IND (4th-most TE yds allowed).
items.why: Historical pairing data + recent absence usage.
items.implication: London WR1 lock; Schultz TE streamer/start.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 util; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs) and Travis Etienne vs LV (49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps; role not there even w/ Kamara).
items.implication: Sit/flex down; Henderson closer but still ranks Stevenson ahead.
items.conflict: Henderson post-fumble 65% snaps/16-5 touches but pass-pro concerns keep Stevenson ranked higher.

items.text: After Stevenson fumble W2, TreVeyon Henderson led NE with 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but ranks Stevenson ahead W3 (pass-pro trust).
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full takeover yet.
